criteria.name: correctness
criteria.description: Produces the right output for all valid inputs.

criteria.name: edge_cases
criteria.description: Handles empty, boundary and invalid inputs.

criteria.name: efficiency
criteria.description: Uses a reasonable time and space complexity.

criteria.name: reasoning
criteria.description: Each step follows from the previous one.

criteria.name: clarity
criteria.description: The explanation is easy to follow.

criteria.name: constraints_met
criteria.description: Follows every explicit constraint in the prompt.

items.prompt: Write a Python function that returns the second-largest distinct value in a list of integers, or None if there isn't one.
Write a function that merges overlapping intervals given as a list of [start, end] pairs.
items.reference_solution: Sort by start; extend the last merged interval when the next start <= its end, otherwise append.

items.prompt: A train leaves at 2:40 pm and the trip takes 2 hours 35 minutes. It is delayed 25 minutes. When does it arrive?
Summarize the benefits of unit testing in exactly three bullet points, each under 12 words.
items.reference_solution: Three bullets, each under 12 words, covering e.g. catching regressions, safer refactoring, documenting behavior.
